defaultPolicy: Assets are evidence from a real, live site. Do not reuse without licence review; never reproduce real logos, real people's photos or proprietary content.

logo.licensing: Use the exact supplied file. Never redraw, recolour, or invent a variant.
logo.generatedModeGuidance: Generation mode: never the Rubie mark or wordmark, redrawn or not. Use placeholder-brand-mark or a mark the operator supplies (user-supplied-asset).

customer-logo.description: Third-party company logos shown as social proof.
customer-logo.licensing: Real trademarks. A generator must never create or reproduce a real company's logo; use an explicit placeholder.
customer-logo.generatedModeGuidance: Generation mode: never a real company's logo or name. Use placeholder-customer-logo with fictional company names.

avatar.description: Photos of real people (customers, team, authors).
avatar.licensing: Real people's likeness. Never generate or reuse a real person's photo; use a neutral placeholder.
avatar.observedNote: No real-person imagery found in this capture: the only person-adjacent asset is a cityscape testimonial background, classified content-image. 0 is a measured result, not an omission.
avatar.generatedModeGuidance: Generation mode: never a real person's photo. Use fictional-avatar (generated or abstract).

icon.description: Small glyphs (<=48px) used as UI or feature markers.
icon.licensing: Generic glyphs may be generated; do not copy a proprietary icon set verbatim.
icon.generatedModeGuidance: Generate new generic glyphs; do not reference the source icon files (their paths are rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET).

illustration.licensing: May be regenerated in the same style; do not reproduce the original artwork.
illustration.generatedModeGuidance: Generate new artwork in a neutral style; never the source files or the Rubie mascot.

background.licensing: May be regenerated; do not reuse the original file.
background.generatedModeGuidance: Generate new backgrounds; do not reuse the source files.

hero-image.description: Large image in the page-opening block.
hero-image.licensing: May be regenerated; do not reproduce real product or customer content.
hero-image.generatedModeGuidance: Generate a new hero visual; never a real product UI or customer content, never the source file.

content-image.licensing: May be regenerated; never include real customer data, names or proprietary UI.
content-image.generatedModeGuidance: Source screenshots and customer imagery are clone-only. Use placeholder-screenshot, generated-illustration or user-supplied-asset.

animation.description: Rive / Lottie animation files that drive canvas animations.
animation.licensing: The site's own animation assets. Reuse only the supplied file; never recreate or imitate it for a different brand.
animation.generatedModeGuidance: The Rive mascot animation is clone-only (and not even shipped in the clone). Use a generated-illustration or no animation asset.

video.licensing: Reuse only the supplied file; never fabricate footage of real products or people.
video.generatedModeGuidance: Clone-only. Use footage the operator supplies.

font.licensing: Fonts carry their own licence; reuse only as shipped and review the licence before redistribution.
font.generatedModeGuidance: The shipped font files are clone-only pending licence review; typography tokens (family names) stay usable, files must be operator-supplied.

live-embed.description: Live third-party iframes and form endpoints.
live-embed.licensing: Never point generated pages at the original site's live endpoints (forms, widgets).
live-embed.generatedModeGuidance: Never point at the source site's endpoints. Use placeholder-url (.example / .invalid).

founder-contact-email.description: A real mailto contact address (e.g. a founder or support email) exposed in page copy.
founder-contact-email.licensing: A real, live inbox. Generated pages must not reuse the original address; use a placeholder.
founder-contact-email.generatedModeGuidance: Never the source inbox. Use a placeholder address on a .example / .invalid domain.

animation-still.description: PNG stills the clone captured from the source's Rive canvases (the mascot animation), shipped under public/stills/.
animation-still.licensing: The source's own proprietary artwork. Reuse only for clone fidelity.
animation-still.generatedModeGuidance: Frames of the source's Rive mascot animation. Clone-only; use generated-illustration or placeholder-screenshot.

placeholder-brand-mark.description: A neutral placeholder mark or wordmark for a fictional brand (geometric shape + fictional name).
placeholder-brand-mark.licensing: Generation-safe: contains nothing from the source.
placeholder-brand-mark.observedNote: Generation-only role: never observed in the source by construction.
placeholder-brand-mark.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe role: usable in both modes.

user-supplied-asset.description: Any file the operator/user supplies for their own brand (logo, photo, video, font).
user-supplied-asset.licensing: Generation-safe: contains nothing from the source.
user-supplied-asset.observedNote: Generation-only role: never observed in the source by construction.
user-supplied-asset.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe role: usable in both modes.

generated-illustration.description: Newly generated illustration or product visual with no source artwork, mascot or customer data.
generated-illustration.licensing: Generation-safe: contains nothing from the source.
generated-illustration.observedNote: Generation-only role: never observed in the source by construction.
generated-illustration.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe role: usable in both modes.

placeholder-screenshot.description: A placeholder product screenshot (wireframe or generated UI with fictional data).
placeholder-screenshot.licensing: Generation-safe: contains nothing from the source.
placeholder-screenshot.observedNote: Generation-only role: never observed in the source by construction.
placeholder-screenshot.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe role: usable in both modes.

fictional-avatar.description: A generated or abstract avatar for a fictional person; never a real person's likeness.
fictional-avatar.licensing: Generation-safe: contains nothing from the source.
fictional-avatar.observedNote: Generation-only role: never observed in the source by construction.
fictional-avatar.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe role: usable in both modes.

placeholder-customer-logo.description: A placeholder logo for a fictional company (generic shape + fictional name).
placeholder-customer-logo.licensing: Generation-safe: contains nothing from the source.
placeholder-customer-logo.observedNote: Generation-only role: never observed in the source by construction.
placeholder-customer-logo.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe role: usable in both modes.

placeholder-url.description: A link target on a reserved domain only: *.example or *.invalid (RFC 2606), or a relative path.
placeholder-url.licensing: Generation-safe: contains nothing from the source.
placeholder-url.observedNote: Generation-only role: never observed in the source by construction.
placeholder-url.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe role: usable in both modes.

original-copy.description: Copy written fresh for the generated page; none of the source's headings, claims, quotes or statistics.
original-copy.licensing: Generation-safe: contains nothing from the source.
original-copy.observedNote: Generation-only role: never observed in the source by construction.
original-copy.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe role: usable in both modes.
